shellCommands.command:
npm run start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/lamp
echo ""
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/lamp?currency=EUR
echo ""
kill $SERVER_PID

npm run start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/nonexistent
echo ""
kill $SERVER_PID

npm run start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/lamp
echo ""
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/nonexistent
echo ""
kill $SERVER_PID

npm run build && (npm run start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i http://localhost:3000/products/nonexistent
echo ""
kill $SERVER_PID)

npm run start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "First request:"
time curl -s http://localhost:3000/products/lamp > /dev/null
echo "Second request:"
time curl -s http://localhost:3000/products/lamp > /dev/null
kill $SERVER_PID
